additional_info.subject: RE: AW: ID0367369-DC/Si-D/DE-[Null] Charging session aborted CRM:00643000775
additional_info.body:
Hi Armin,
I hope this email finds you well.
We have analyzed the logs for the day mentioned in the webform to troubleshoot what is causing the charging session to be aborted. There were multiple charging sessions, and a few of them were stopped remotely via the app. Additionally, in some sessions, no authorization was done, which prevented the charging from starting. Please find the attached snapshot for your reference.
In the below one there was no Authorization done due to which session was aborted.
As we are now reviewing the charger, there are no issues with it. All the outlets are available, and the charger health is good with no critical error flags.
Please let us know if you have any further queries. If not, we shall proceed with closing this ticket.
Thank you for your patience & understanding.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Shrey
